name: Apothecary
text: Hey Pierre

name: Pierre
text: Hey old man, got anything I can make some new colors with?

name: Apothecary
text: Listen here pissair, I ain't that old

name: Pierre
text: Please, you fart and last centuries corn dust comes out

name: Apothecary
text: ...Jackass kids these days.

name: Apothecary
text: Yea, I've got a curious ingredient that has a lovely blue color to it

name: Apothecary
text: You could use it to make some paint

name: Apothecary
text: Although, you should be careful not to eat any of it

name: Pierre
text: Why's that? Is it poisonous?

name: Apothecary
text: No, nothing like that

name: Apothecary
text: Just gave me the jitters, sent my ass flying into the wall

name: Pierre
text: ...I'll keep that in mind

name: Pierre
text: Thanks for the help old man.

name: Pierre
text: Do you have anything else for some different colors?

name: Apothecary
text: Well I know of some beautiful flowers in the forest

name: Apothecary
text: Only problem was I couldn't get to them.

name: Apothecary
text: There were on a ledge I couldn't reach

name: Apothecary
text: Not as spry as I used to be you know

name: Apothecary
text: If you'd fetch them for me though...

name: Apothecary
text: I could process them for you

name: Pierre
text: No problem old man, I'll look into it!
